maria_pm: Quick sync — we need a deploy plan for the tenant canary for the regional model swap next week. Plan: feature-flagged, two-stage canary, explicit telemetry contract from SRE/CS before ramp. Any immediate concerns?

ace_eng: Proposed flags: `canary/tenant/{tenant_id}` and `region_override`. Rollout recipe: 1% -> 10% -> 50% with hold windows (30m). Note: KV cache warmup could skew early latencies.

sam_sre: +1 on the stages. Telemetry contract (must be measured at each hold window):
- latency: p50/p90/p99 (compare to baseline)
- error-rate: 4xx/5xx split, and client-visible errors
- throughput: req/s and token/sec changes
- cost delta: token CPU/GPU time estimate
Hard gates (immediate rollback): `p90 increase > 12%` OR `5xx rate > 0.5%` OR `error-rate increase > 3x baseline`
Soft gates (pause & investigate): `p90 +6-12% for 2 windows` OR `cost +20% for 2 windows`
Also require shadow validation for 48h prior to the 1% step.

julie_cs: CS asks: include an opt-out per-customer flag and explicit enterprise notice 24h before their traffic is included. Need `customer_optout` and `enterprise_hold` mechanics. Also require a fallback that pins a tenant to the previous model for 24h after any rollback.

ance_eng: Implementation note: we can add `rollback_pin` metadata in route config. Example flag payload to store in the flags service:
```json
{"percent":10,"hold_mins":30,"metrics_window":"5m","rollback_pin":true}
```
This is what the rollout controller will read.

maria_pm: Launch gates checklist (pre-signoff):
- Telemetry contract validated in shadow for 48h
- Two enterprise customers on the notified list confirmed
- Playbook + oncall assigned and on Slack #eng-oncall
- Smoke tests and failure drill (region outage -> global fallback) completed
Who takes primary oncall for the first window?

sam_sre: :raising_hand: I'll be primary oncall for the first window. Requesting `deploy-bot` notifications in #eng-oncall for each step. Also want a smoke test harness endpoint `smoke/tenants/sample-conn` to run right after each step.

ance_eng: I'll add the rollout recipe to the repo at `deploy/recipes/tenant_canary.md`. One more ask: precompute shard mapping to avoid imbalance when we jump to 50% (prevents noisy neighbor on a few shards).

julie_cs: I'll prepare the enterprise comms draft. For enterprise customers we'll include rollback SLA and direct POC. Also will request the `manual_freeze` flag support so CS can stop progression immediately.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout job created: job_id=rc-2026-09-17-14, initial 1% at 2026-09-17T14:00Z. Steps: 1% -> hold 30m -> 10% -> hold 30m -> 50%. Shadow run completed (48h) and CI checks green.

maria_pm: OK — action items: ace to add flag schema + recipe by EOD, sam to publish telemetry contract doc to #eng-sre, julie to draft enterprise comms and opt-out instructions. Reconvene 12:00 UTC tomorrow for signoff. :white_check_mark:
